// Returns the counter-clockwise angle (in radians) that the vector makes with
// the x-axis. Return value in [0, 2pi)
function polarAngle(vector) {
    const theta = Math.atan2(vector[1], vector[0]);
    return theta < 0 ? 2 * Math.PI + theta : theta;
}
// Get the euclidean magnitude of the vector
function magnitude(vector) {
    return Math.sqrt(vector[0] * vector[0] + vector[1] * vector[1]);
}
// Get the polar representation of the vector (as [magnitude, angle])
function getPolarVector(vector) {
    return [magnitude(vector), polarAngle(vector)];
}
// Arguments must be in the range [0, 2pi)
function getAngleDistance(alpha, beta) {
    let d = Math.abs(beta - alpha);
    while (d > 2 * Math.PI) {
        d -= 2 * Math.PI;
    }
    if (d > Math.PI) {
        d = 2 * Math.PI - d;
    }
    return d;
}
function getAngleDifference(alpha, beta) {
    const d = alpha - beta;
    return d < 0 ? 2 * Math.PI + d : d;
}
// Given an array of vectors, return a vector that bisects the highest angle
// distance between two circularly (??) consecutive vectors in the array.
function getBestGapVector(vectors) {
    // For a single vector, return its negation, i.e. literally the opposite
    // direction.
    if (vectors.length == 1) {
        return _commontypes__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__.Util.scalarVectorMultiply(-1, _commontypes__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__.Util.getNormalized(vectors[0]));
    }
    const polarVectors = vectors.map(getPolarVector);
    polarVectors.sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
    let maxI = 0;
    let maxD = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < polarVectors.length; i++) {
        let j = i == polarVectors.length - 1 ? 0 : i + 1;
        const d = getAngleDifference(polarVectors[j][1], polarVectors[i][1]);
        if (d > maxD) {
            maxD = d;
            maxI = i;
        }
    }
    let midWayAngle = polarVectors[maxI][1] + (maxD / 2);
    if (midWayAngle >= 2 * Math.PI) {
        midWayAngle = midWayAngle - 2 * Math.PI;
    }
    return [Math.cos(midWayAngle), Math.sin(midWayAngle)];
}

function isInteger(s) {
    return !isNaN(parseInt(s));
}
class LocalGraphDrawingStore {
    constructor(graphTabs) {
        this.graphTabs = graphTabs;
    }
    static getInstance(graphTabs) {
        if (LocalGraphDrawingStore.instance == null) {
            LocalGraphDrawingStore.instance = new LocalGraphDrawingStore(graphTabs);
        }
        return LocalGraphDrawingStore.instance;
    }
    getAllStoredInfo() {
        const infos = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
            if (isInteger(localStorage.key(i))) {
                const info = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(localStorage.key(i)));
                infos.push({ id: parseInt(localStorage.key(i)), name: info[0] });
            }
        }
        return infos;
    }
    getGraphDrawingById(id) {
        const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(id.toString()));
        return _drawing_graphdrawing__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__.GraphDrawing.fromJsonString(this.graphTabs, s[1]);
    }
    storeGraphDrawing(graphDrawing, name) {
        const allIds = this.getAllStoredInfo().map(info => info.id);
        var nextId;
        if (allIds.length == 0) {
            nextId = 1;
        }
        else {
            nextId = Math.max(...allIds) + 1;
        }
        const storedDrawing = [name, graphDrawing.toJsonString()];
        localStorage.setItem(nextId.toString(), JSON.stringify(storedDrawing));
        this.changeCallback();
        return nextId;
    }
    deleteGraphDrawing(id) {
        const ids = this.getAllStoredInfo().map(i => i.id);
        if (ids.includes(id)) {
            localStorage.removeItem(id.toString());
            this.changeCallback();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    listenForChanges(callback) {
        this.changeCallback = callback;
    }
}

                newId = this.createCompleteGraph(formSubmission.numVertices, formSubmission.weighted, formSubmission.directed);
                break;
            case "Complete-Bipartite-Graph":

        element.click();
        document.body.removeChild(element);
